APIs.verify_experiment(document): Raise ValueError on a defect. Return independent-finite-certified-nogood-comparison-audit-v1; valid_saved_experiment may be true with unresolved UNKNOWN records and all_queries_completed false.

document_wire.cases: Exactly the unchanged B07 then B08 original case dictionaries. Each case requires original, queries, discovery, discovery_audits, learned, arms, point_arm_audits, ordinary_arm_audits, timings, original_oracle, proposal_log. Extra metadata fields are permitted without receiving scientific/resource authority.
document_wire.queries: Exactly 48 per context: for i=0..3, j=0..3 except i=j, b=0,1, c=0,1 in that nested order; {i,j,b,c,seeds}, seeds sorted [[i,b],[j,1-c]].
document_wire.discovery: 48 complete raw point-result records plus 48 corresponding raw point-auditor reports. Every discovery model has only original clauses and all original guards active; fresh exact query boundary and empty placement root.
document_wire.learned: Up to two records {clause:[[variable,sign],...],discovery_query_index:int}; sign is exact +1 or -1, clauses sorted by variable index. No proof routes or predeclared learned clause values are encoded in this Source.
document_wire.proposal_log: Every complete EXHAUSTED discovery root in query order. Required fields discovery_query_index,clause,is_original,is_duplicate,entailed,selected. Duplicate means a prior exhausted root proposed that same normalized clause. Extra metadata is permitted.
document_wire.arms: Exact ordinary_no, ordinary_learned, point_no, point_learned maps; each has 48 raw results in query order. Both point arms include the same complete original+selected learned tuple/guard inventory; only learned guard markings differ. Ordinary no arm has original clauses; learned arm original plus exactly selected clauses.
document_wire.audits: point_arm_audits has point_no and point_learned arrays; ordinary_arm_audits has ordinary_no and ordinary_learned arrays. One audit per result. Whole verifier recomputes each ordinary audit; supplied point-audit completion/status fields are matched, with ROOT required separately to invoke exact raw point auditor on corresponding immutable results.
document_wire.original_oracle: Raw existing evaluate_case(original) result. All assignments, complete ordered clause truth rows, and complete marked/unmarked accepted sets are independently checked here. Other original-oracle prefix/unit metadata is outside this checker scope.
document_wire.timings: Retained metadata. This checker grants no clock, memory, native ownership, startup or speedup acceptance.

mathematical_checks: Directly evaluate every complete assignment of each original four-variable CNF. Filter query assumptions without using solver-supplied expected answers.
Only complete root EXHAUSTED may propose the negation of the entire two-assumption query prefix. No subtree minimization, assumption discharge, human clause injection or UNKNOWN proposal.

Independently require original-F truth-table entailment and choose exactly the first two distinct non-original entailed clauses in the frozen query order. Retain originals, duplicate proposals, later proposals and all raw unresolved discovery results.

Recompute all original satisfying assignments after adding learned clauses and require exact equality. Check every FOUND witness against full original/query truth and every complete exhausted outcome against empty extensions.

Independently reconstruct complete point model wires from all bit/tuple/guard data, including forbidden tuple candidates, all positive unit roots, marking-only ports, exact assigned zero versus absence, query fixed m and marking epoch. Both replay point inventories retain learned gadgets even when guards are inactive.
Check 96 discovery and 384 replay result slots with fresh root states. UNKNOWN remains unresolved and provides neither witness nor clause.
ordinary_trace_checks: Every state is a complete sorted exact assignment, with Boolean integer coercion rejected. All seed occurrences preserved; each child extends parent by precisely the declared one unset variable.

Every node has its full literal/ordered-clause scan, including satisfied clauses and all unassigned ports. Global first conflict precedes first unit; only then branch at smallest unassigned variable with zero before one.
Explicit stack checks every parent alternative, child, full restore, successful stop and complete finite exhaustion. Complete solutions assign all variables even if clauses became true earlier.

Every emitted node/scan/unit/branch/assignment/restore/conflict/solution count and trace index is exact. Complete literal checks equal full scan count times all clause occurrences. UNKNOWN permits only one interrupted scan with honestly bounded partial charges.

UNKNOWN location and its actual exhausted node/literal or trace-reservation gate are checked; reserved restore/final events must restore root exactly. No success may be revoked into UNKNOWN after an ordinary completed reserved return.
independence_and_limits: No imports/calls of ordinary solver, point engine, prior Boolean oracle, raw point auditor, project Sources, IO, native clocks or resource APIs. Raw point trace audit is intentionally performed by ROOT separately; its supplied report is not an untrusted proof substitute.

Author previously authored the separate finite truth oracle and point raw-trace auditor; neither is executed or imported by this Source. Ordinary Source author is arithmetic; point Source author is diagnosis. Distinct review is required for this new verifier.

Counts from different representations are not equal work units. Replayed discovery catalogue is not held-out generalization. No statistical speedup, RL, general point-engine conformance, fixed Wang universality or original arithmetic-Q qualification.
